en.title: GTA Modder Creates Inter-Game Portals, Uniting Three Classic Worlds
en.summary: A dedicated modder has achieved what many thought impossible: seamlessly merging the worlds of Grand Theft Auto 3, Vice City, and San Andreas. Players can now travel instantly between these iconic locations, experiencing a true GTA multiverse.
en.body:
For years, fans have dreamt of experiencing the distinct yet interconnected worlds of Rockstar's early 3D Grand Theft Auto titles together. Now, a remarkable modder has turned that dream into a reality, creating a system that allows players to jump between **Grand Theft Auto 3**, **Vice City**, and **San Andreas** with the flick of a switch. This groundbreaking achievement, dubbed the 'inter-GTA portal' by observers, effectively brings the concept of a Grand Theft Auto multiverse to life long before **Grand Theft Auto 6** is even on the horizon.

The modder, known as **DryxioGTA**, has developed a system where three distinct portals are placed within the world of **San Andreas**. Stepping through each portal instantly transports the player to the corresponding game and its unique setting. Crucially, the mod doesn't just switch maps; it also switches the player character to the protagonist of that specific game, seamlessly integrating the experience. This isn't a simple map swap or a video playback; the mod ensures that each game world continues to run in real-time, maintaining its own save data, missions, and environmental simulation, including traffic and physics.

The technical prowess behind this mod is astonishing. **DryxioGTA** confirmed that all three games are running within the same process, sharing a single Direct3D device. Each portal functions as a live GPU texture, with the game world actually rendering behind it. This allows for truly unprecedented interactions between the different GTA universes. In a demonstration video, **DryxioGTA** showcased the ability to shoot through a portal from one game into another, affecting the NPCs in the target world. This level of inter-connectivity opens up a universe of possibilities for emergent gameplay and fan-made content.

## A Dream Realized for GTA Fans

This mod is a testament to the enduring passion of the Grand Theft Auto community. For players who grew up with or have a deep affection for the early 3D era of the series, the ability to revisit Liberty City, Vice City, and San Andreas in such an integrated fashion is a monumental feat. It allows for a unique form of nostalgia, blending the distinct atmospheres and gameplay mechanics of each title into a cohesive whole. The fact that this is achieved through player ingenuity, rather than official developer tools, highlights the incredible creativity that thrives within the gaming landscape. The community reaction has been overwhelmingly positive, with many expressing awe at the technical achievement and eager anticipation for further development.

## What's Next for the GTA Multiverse Mod

The mod is still in active development, and **DryxioGTA** has not yet announced a formal name or a public release date. However, the demonstration suggests a significant step forward in what is possible with game modding. Future updates will likely focus on refining the experience, potentially adding more interactive elements, and ensuring stability across all three games. Fans will undoubtedly be keeping a close watch on **DryxioGTA**'s channels for any news regarding its availability.

content_raw: As a series, Grand Theft Auto has spent decades cycling between the same three locations, with each variation of Liberty City, Vice City and San Andreas being more detailed than the last. But players haven't been able to explore all three locations at once since the release of the original. Until now. A modder has done what Grand Theft Auto hasn't since 1997, creating a mod that lets players travel instantaneously between the settings of Grand Theft Auto 3 , Vice City , and San Andreas . And it's all thanks to that most underutilised of game technologies—portals. Veteran Grand Theft Auto tinkerer DryxioGTA posted a video of the mod—which is still in development and doesn't seem to have a proper name yet—on YouTube (via GamesRadar ) The clip shows the player travelling between three brightly coloured portals located in San Andreas' Grove Street. Walking through each portal transports the player instantly to the relevant game and location, switching to the appropriate player character in the process. DryxioGTA provided some technical details in the video's comments. He confirmed that all three games are running "inside the same process, sharing one Direct 3D device" and that "each portal is a live GPU texture" with the relevant game "actually running behind it, it's not a video or a captured window". DryxioGTA also says that the three worlds maintain their own saves, missions, and settings, and that they continue to run the world state, including traffic and physics, in real time. Perhaps the most remarkable aspect of the mod is that the portals don't just let the player travel between cities, they also allow for interactions between those cities. DryxioGTA demonstrates this by shooting through a portal, gunning down several civilians. This causes peds in his current world to attack him and triggers a wanted rating. It's seriously impressive work, and the GTA fans responding in the video's comments are clearly bowled over. "The fact that you can shoot the peds and other objects through the portals is just beyond unimaginably insane," writes li_B4shar_il , while ross3695_basedhax observes that "We got inter-GTA portals before GTA 6." In fairness, it's not that long before Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar's hugely anticipated sequel is due to land in November, and that fact alone has already had a substantial impact on gaming. Every other developer is scurrying to get out of the way of Rockstar's behemoth, resulting in the next three months being crowded with dozens of highly anticipated launches.
